title: Fold Reordered List

monster.name: Interleaving Phantom
monster.title: Weaver of Folded Head-Tails
monster.defeatQuote: Interleaving the first half and reversed second half succeeded!

description: You are given an array of node values representing a singly linked-list: `L0 → L1 → … → Ln - 1 → Ln`. Reorder the list to be: `L0 → Ln → L1 → Ln - 1 → L2 → Ln - 2 → …`. Return the reordered array of values.
solutionCode:
def reorderList(head: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    if len(head) <= 2: return head
    left, right = 0, len(head) - 1
    res = []
    while left <= right:
        if left == right:
            res.append(head[left])
            break
        res.append(head[left])
        res.append(head[right])
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return res
hints: Find middle, reverse the second half, and interleave nodes.
